Finished assembly is one printed knob and one M5 nut.","questions":[{"text":"Can the nut dimensions be measured?","answer":"No; use best judgment."},{"text":"Did the previous print accept and retain the nut?","answer":"No usable fit result was available."}],"params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":17,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"socket_af_clearance":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total across-flats clearance."},"bore_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral clearance."},"floor_h":{"value":2.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"root_h":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_t":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_w":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_gap":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_inset":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_clearance":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_projection":{"value":0.45,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_land_h":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"ramp_h":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_r":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_offset":{"value":17,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":8,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    a=(p.nut_af+p.socket_af_clearance)/2
    zcatch=p.floor_h+p.nut_h+p.catch_clearance
    H=zcatch+p.catch_land_h+p.ramp_h
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(H)
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        theta=2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        cutter=cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.grip_cut_offset*math.cos(theta),p.grip_cut_offset*math.sin(theta)).circle(p.grip_cut_r).extrude(H)
        body=body.cut(cutter)
    R=2*a/math.sqrt(3)
    pts=[(R*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),R*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_h).polyline(pts).close().extrude(H-p.floor_h))
    for angle in (0,120,240):
        x0=a-p.slot_inset
        x1=a+p.tab_t+p.slot_gap
        slot=cq.Workplane('XY').box(x1-x0,p.tab_w+2*p.slot_gap,H-p.root_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((x0,0,p.root_h)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle)
        body=body.cut(slot)
        finger=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.tab_t,p.tab_w,H-p.root_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((a,0,p.root_h))
        profile=[(a,zcatch),(a-p.catch_projection,zcatch),(a-p.catch_projection,zcatch+p.catch_land_h),(a,H)]
        lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.tab_w/2,both=True)
        body=body.union(finger.union(lip).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    return body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bore_clearance)/2).extrude(H)).clean()
","print_orientation":"Closed flat underside on bed at z=0; socket faces upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut loads through the top. Prefer bolt insertion through the closed underside so tightening load seats the nut against the floor."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    a=(p.nut_af+p.socket_af_clearance)/2
    zcatch=p.floor_h+p.nut_h+p.catch_clearance
    H=zcatch+p.catch_land_h+p.ramp_h
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(H)
    R=2*a/math.sqrt(3)
    pts=[(R*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),R*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_h).polyline(pts).close().extrude(H-p.floor_h))
    for angle in (0,120,240):
        x0=a-p.slot_inset
        x1=a+p.tab_t+p.slot_gap
        slot=cq.Workplane('XY').box(x1-x0,p.tab_w+2*p.slot_gap,H-p.root_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((x0,0,p.root_h)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle)
        body=body.cut(slot)
        finger=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.tab_t,p.tab_w,H-p.root_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((a,0,p.root_h))
        lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(a,zcatch),(a-p.catch_projection,zcatch),(a-p.catch_projection,zcatch+p.catch_land_h),(a,H)]).close().extrude(p.tab_w/2,both=True)
        body=body.union(finger.union(lip).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    return body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bore_clearance)/2).extrude(H)).clean()

Some initial angular play is normal."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print fit_coupon first if possible: 0.2 mm layers, at least four walls, 100% infill, no supports. Inspect the slicer preview to ensure the spring walls remain continuous and their isolation slots stay open. Use identical settings for knob.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"tool":"Slicer"},{"n":"2","text":"After cooling, remove strings without levering on the tabs. Align the nut flats with the socket and press straight down with a thumb. The ramps should spread the tabs, then let them spring inward above the seated nut. Do not hammer or use a vise.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"Check that the nut is fully recessed and seated on the floor. Invert and shake lightly: it must stay in. Test that an M5 bolt passes through the underside hole and threads through the nut. Stop if a tab cracks, whitens or stays bent. The 7.50 mm catch-entry envelope is not the main socket width.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"If insertion jams, increase socket_af_clearance by 0.1 mm and reprint the coupon. If the seated nut falls out with intact tabs, increase catch_projection by 0.1 mm and retest; this also increases insertion force. Do not print the full knob using an adjustment that has not passed the coupon tests.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"5","text":"To recover the test nut, thread an M5 bolt into it from below and gently ease the tabs outward while lifting the nut, one catch at a time. Do not pull forcefully against the catches. Alternatively sacrifice the coupon to recover the nut, protecting your fingers from sharp PLA edges.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Print knob with the successful parameters and settings. Cool it, clear strings, press the nut in, and repeat the inversion and through-bolt checks. Only knob and nut are used in the finished assembly; no glue or separate retainer is required.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"7","text":"Use for light hand tightening only. Prefer passing the application bolt through the closed underside into the nut, so the solid floor carries axial load. The catches retain the loose nut; they are not structural retainers for loads pulling the nut out of the open face. Do not use a wrench or expose PLA to heat. The application-specific M5 bolt is not included in this nut-knob assembly.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
